title: Accounts Assistant
description:
The Accounts Assistant role in Cardiff is all about keeping things running smoothly in the accounting and finance department of a business services organisation. You'll handle day-to-day financial tasks, helping to ensure everything balances and operates efficiently.

Client Details

As a business services organisation based in Cardiff.Our client is a well-established international organisation that delivers specialist services to governments, public sector bodies, and global businesses across Europe. With a collaborative and supportive culture, they combine the stability of an established business with the opportunity to gain exposure to international operations, making it an excellent environment for career development and long-term growth.

Description
- Process invoices and payments accurately and on time.
- Reconcile bank statements and monitor accounts for discrepancies.
- Assist with preparing financial reports and management accounts.
- Maintain and update financial records in line with company policies.
- Support the month-end and year-end closing processes.
- Respond to internal and external financial queries promptly and professionally.
- Collaborate with colleagues to ensure compliance with accounting regulations.
- Provide general administrative support to the accounting and finance team.

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- A good understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Experience using accounting software and financial systems.
- Strong numerical skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a willingness to learn.

Job Offer
- Salary of £30,000
- Yearly bonus.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Private health care.
- Potential study support.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant Cardiff Hybrid

Are you an ambitious Finance Assistant / Accounts Assistant looking for a role where you can genuinely make an impact?

We're working with a fast-paced, internationally focused SME based in Cardiff that is restructuring its finance function and looking for a Finance Assistant to join the team at an exciting time of growth and development.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on, organised and involved across a broad range of finance activities, rather than being restricted to one area.

The Role

Reporting to the Financial Controller, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, ensuring everything runs smoothly and accurately while supporting month-end, reporting and wider business processes.

You'll be trusted to manage your workload independently, with support and training from the Financial Controller.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the finance inbox and responding to internal and external queries
- Processing purchase invoices and preparing supplier payments
- Raising sales invoices and maintaining billing schedules
- Chasing outstanding payments and supporting credit control
- Completing bank reconciliations across multiple accounts
- Processing employee expenses
- Preparing payroll for review and supporting payroll administration
- Maintaining accurate and organised financial records
- Posting journals and preparing month-end reconciliations
- Supporting VAT return preparation
- Assisting with management accounts and supporting schedules
- Maintaining accurate project cost allocations and supporting budget tracking
- Managing compliance processes, including KYC and AML
- Supporting client, sponsor and supplier onboarding
- Assisting with payroll, benefits and wider HR administration
- Helping to improve processes and document finance procedures

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is reliable, commercially minded and confident managing the day-to-day responsibilities of a busy finance function.

You'll ideally have:
- AAT qualification, studying towards AAT, or equivalent bookkeeping experience
- Previous experience in day-to-day bookkeeping, ideally within an SME
- Good working knowledge of Xero
- Experience with multi-currency transactions and reconciliations
- Strong Excel skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- The ability to manage your workload independently and meet deadlines

Experience with payroll, international invoicing, EU VAT, professional services, events, media or project accounting would be advantageous.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a small, collaborative and internationally focused business where you'll have genuine ownership of your work and exposure across finance, compliance and wider business operations.

You'll benefit from:
- Hybrid working in Cardiff
- Competitive salary based on experience
- Pension contribution scheme
- 25 days annual leave + public holidays
- Training and support from an experienced Financial Controller
- A broad role with scope to develop your finance career

If you're an AAT-qualified, AAT-studying or experienced finance professional looking for a varied role where no two days are quite the same, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to find out more.

title: Finance Officer
description:
Finance Officer

Join a Growing Technology Business

We're looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Finance Officer to join our Cardiff-based team.

Operating within the exciting Technology sector, our business specialises in distribution rather than manufacturing, creating a fast-paced environment where finance plays a key role in supporting daily operations and delivering excellent service to customers and partners.

While strong finance skills are important, we're equally focused on finding someone who will thrive within our team culture. We're a sociable, supportive group that enjoys working together, celebrating successes, and creating a positive environment where everyone feels valued. Cultural fit is genuinely important for this role.

The Role

As Finance Officer, you'll support the smooth running of the finance function and play a vital role in maintaining accurate financial records and processes.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions
- Managing customer and supplier invoices
- Reconciling bank accounts and financial records
- Supporting month-end finance activities
- Assisting with cash flow monitoring and reporting
- Chasing outstanding payments and managing credit control activities
- Maintaining accurate financial documentation and records
- Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc duties and projects

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Previous experience in a finance, accounts or bookkeeping position
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail
- Comfortable working with financial systems and Microsoft Excel
- A strong communicator who enjoys working collaboratively
- Positive, approachable and willing to get involved with the wider team
- Able to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment
- Reliable, professional and eager to contribute

What You'll Get
- Competitive salary of £30,000
- 12-month fixed-term contract with an established business
- Opportunity to gain experience within the Technology industry
- Friendly, welcoming and sociable team culture
- Supportive working environment where your contribution is recognised
- Modern Cardiff office location

Interested?

If you're a finance professional who enjoys working in a collaborative environment and wants to be part of a team that values both professionalism and personality, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.
